There is a patrol of lost [[White Mantle]] wandering around that needs eliminating. The [[Shining Blade]] could also use whatever resources they can salvage off them.

{{TOCright}}
== Quest information ==
=== Objectives ===
* Tell [[Gareth Quickblade]] about the lost [[White Mantle]] patrol.
* Meet the [[Shining Blade]] scouts in [[Silverwood]].
* Seek out and  destroy the White Mantle patrol.
* Collect [5...0] more [[Ruined Armor|ruined White Mantle armor[s]]].
* Take the 5 ruined White Mantle armors back to Gareth Quickblade.

=== Reward ===
* 500 [[Experience]]
* 100 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only)
* {{w}} {{skill icon|Crushing Blow}}
* {{r}} {{skill icon|Barbed Trap}}
* {{mo}} {{skill icon|Contemplation of Purity}}
* {{n}} {{skill icon|Rend Enchantments}}
* {{me}} {{skill icon|Arcane Thievery}}
* {{e}} {{skill icon|Conjure Frost}}

== Walkthrough ==
From [[Quarrel Falls]], travel north to find [[Alari Doubleblade]] (see first map) and obtain the [[quest]]. Once you have the quest, [[map travel]] back to [[Quarrel Falls]] and talk to Gareth. It is suggested that first-time players not do this until you complete [[Bloodstone Fen]], otherwise the actions you need to undertake in the quest will confuse you. Completing Bloodstone Fen will also put you right in Quarrel Falls.

Go outside and meet up with the [[Shining Blade Scout]] and two [[Shining Blade Ranger]]s. They will head off to the north (see second map) for you to follow. They will [[aggro]] everything in their path and can die easily, but don't need to be kept alive for quest completion. Alternatively, you can head out of [[Bloodstone Fen (outpost)|Bloodstone Fen]] (see third map). Kill the patrol, and pick up the [[Ruined Armor]]s they drop. Map travel back to Quarrel Falls for your reward.

== Dialogue ==

=== Initial dialogue ===
; Alari Doubleblade
: ''"I have learned recently that a White Mantle patrol entered the forest and has become lost. They were last spotted somewhere in Silverwood. Report to '''Gareth Quickblade''' in '''Quarrel Falls''' and let him know that there are White Mantle in the woods.

:''Well, what are you waiting for?"''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I'll report to Gareth immediately.
| decline = You could be a little more civil.
| ask = Let '''Gareth Quickblade''' in '''Quarrel Falls''' know that a White Mantle patrol has gotten lost in Silverwood.
}}

=== Intermediate dialogue ===
; Gareth Quickblade
: ''"The White Mantle think they can send patrols into our forests and not pay the price? They'll soon learn the cost of crossing the Shining Blade! I'll have several scouts meet you in Silverwood. They'll lead you to this White Mantle patrol. Wipe out the patrol and bring me their armor when you are done. We should be able to salvage some useable steel from them."''

'''Shining Blade Scout:''' ''"Follow me. Hurry, before the White Mantle patrol escapes the forest."''

=== Reward dialogue ===
; Gareth Quickblade
: ''"Well done. Not only have we destroyed one of their patrols, but this armor should salvage into enough steel to equip many of our scouts."''

== Notes ==
* You can skip speaking to Gareth Quickblade by simply [[Zone|rezoning]] into Silverwood and killing the White Mantle patrol.
* You can skip speaking to the Shining Blade Scouts by [[map travel|map traveling]] to Bloodstone Fen, then zoning into Silverwood, taking a left, and killing the patrol without them.
